name: 28429 · Castle Hayne, NC
findings: ZIP 28429 (Castle Hayne) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28429 (Castle Hayne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28429 (Castle Hayne) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
